description_en: Verifies the authenticity of an enterprise identity based on business registration data from authoritative data sources, and returns the verify your identity - Enterprise account result
description_zh: 企业二三四要素认证服务基于权威数据源的工商信息数据，用于校验企业本身身份的真实性，输出企业认证结果
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth ent-element-verify --scene-code withdraw --merchant-biz-id 321980000193000 --merchant-user-id 432000421 --user-authorization 1 --info-verify-type ENT_2META --license-no 32132000328932 --ent-name '000有限公司' --legal-person-name '张00' --legal-person-cert-no 370105000003892 --api-version 2022-11-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EntElementVerify

parameters.help_en: The scene code. The value can contain letters, digits, and underscores, with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 场景码。支持字母、数字、下划线的组合，最长32位
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The merchant-defined unique business ID, used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain letters and digits, with a maximum length of 32 characters. Make sure the value is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The merchant-side user ID. The value can contain letters and digits, with a maximum length of 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧用户ID。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位
parameters.name: merchant_user_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether user authorization is obtained. Valid values:
1: Authorization is obtained.
0: Authorization is not obtained
parameters.help_zh:
是否获得得用户授权。
1：获得授权
0：未获得授权
parameters.name: user_authorization

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise element verification type. Valid values:
ENT_2META: two-element verification
ENT_3META: three-element verification
ENT_4META: four-element verification
parameters.help_zh:
企业要素核验类型。
ENT_2META：二要素
ENT_3META：三要素
ENT_4META：四要素
parameters.name: info_verify_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the legal representative. This parameter is required for three-element and four-element verification scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 法人姓名。三要素、四要素场景必传
parameters.name: legal_person_name

parameters.help_en: The ID card number of the legal representative. This parameter is required for the four-element verification scenario
parameters.help_zh: 法人身份证号。四要素场景必传
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_no

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: Consistent.
2: Inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码。
1：核验一致
2：核验不一致
3：未查得

OpenTime.description_en:
The business operation period, including the start time and end time.
Format: yyyy-MM-dd/yyyy-MM-dd.
Example: 2018-09-25/9999-09-09
OpenTime.description_zh:
营业期限：营业开始时间和结束时间。
格式：yyyy-MM-dd/yyyy-MM-dd。
返回示例：2018-09-25/9999-09-09

ReasonCode.description_en:
The description of ReasonCode:

100: Verification consistent.

201: Person-enterprise verification inconsistent.

202: Enterprise two-element verification inconsistent.

301: Enterprise not found. Verification cannot be performed.

302: Legal representative does not exist in the database.
<warning>This field has been deprecated since June 15, 2023. Existing customers who have already integrated are not affected.></warning>
ReasonCode.description_zh:
ReasonCode说明：

100：核验一致

201：人企核验不一致

202：企业二要素核验不一致

301：查无企业，无法校验

302：法人在库中不存在
<warning>此字段于2023年6月15日停止使用，已接入老客户不受影响。></warning>

ReasonDetail.description_en:
The inconsistency details. Multiple inconsistent items are separated by commas. Valid values:
LegalPersonNameFlag: The legal representative name is inconsistent.
LegalPersonCertNoFlag: The legal representative ID card number is inconsistent.
EntNameFlag: The enterprise name is inconsistent.
LicenseNoFlag: The business license number is inconsistent
ReasonDetail.description_zh:
不一致详情，出现多项不一致会以英文逗号隔开。
LegalPersonNameFlag：法人名称不一致
LegalPersonCertNoFlag：法人证件号码不一致
EntNameFlag：企业名称不一致
LicenseNoFlag：营业执照号不一致

Status.description_en:
The business operation status of the enterprise. Valid values:
1: In operation (open).
2: Relocated.
3: Deregistered.
4: Revoked.
5: Rescinded.
6: Suspended.
0: Other
Status.description_zh:
企业经营状态。
1：在营（开业）
2：迁出
3：注销
4：吊销
5：撤销
6：停业
0：其他
